project.title: Archivio Fondazione Luki Massa
project.description: Digitization and cataloging of an archive of lesbian and feminist activism in Bologna, 1976-2015.
project.introText: Digitization of the archive of Luki Massa, which documents lesbian and feminist activism from 1976 to 2015 and was inventoried by Emanuela Fiorletta in 2023.
project.middleText: The work covers five of the archive's series: political groups, lesbian and feminist conferences, seminars and demonstrations, other lesbian, feminist and LGBTQI+ groups, the lesbian and feminist press, and Luki Massa's own notes and writings. Every scan follows a shared nomenclature (archive, series, subseries, file, documentary unit, page), and spreadsheets record the title, date, medium, material and a short description of each unit.

summary.brief: Digitizing the archive of Luki Massa, which documents lesbian and feminist activism from 1976 to 2015.
summary.method: A shared file nomenclature (archive, series, file, unit, page) and a catalog record for every unit.
summary.outcome: In progress: five series being digitized.

project.shows: Careful, standards-based cataloging of a community archive.
